discrepancy_leads: L-01 Extra arm: logs/ holds two successful Gemini 2.5 Pro harmful logs (22-10-27 and 22-11-15, both revision bd5d9bf); the docs report one 44-sample result and the per-batch JSONL is described as 176 rows (4 runs), so one log is an unreported rerun.

L-02 Unreported partial runs: three error logs (Claude Sonnet 4.5, 1 sample of a 176-sample dataset; Claude Sonnet 5 harmful 4/44 and benign 20/44; the docs mention an expired-key 401 for the first Claude attempt) and two unfinished GPT-4o harmful logs (18 + 10 samples, scored, no header) are in logs/ but in no doc table.

L-03 Scorer identity not in-record: patched-judge, -v2 and -v3 logs were scored by the author's locally patched scorer copies, but their headers presumably name the stock combined_scorer, inspect_evals 0.20.0 and task version 8; revision.commit is a kexin-repo commit or null. The variant is recoverable only from the directory and the explanation text (AER bench identity would understate the difference).

L-04 [CORRECTED by fact-check 2026-10-14] Header eval.revision (phase-10h census per_log): 35 logs record origin Kexin-xu-01/agentharm.git with one of 7 kexin-repo commits (bd5d9bf, ee04515, 0b88ad1, d393605, 545a638, 1c38908, 8a12ac0), each the repo HEAD when the run started; 1 log (Claude Sonnet 4.5 error log) records origin UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_evals.git @ 360484a (upstream v0.20.0); 30 finished logs record no revision (24 vLLM logs and the 6 patched-judge v1 logs of Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash-Lite); the 2 unfinished logs have no header. Origin and commit are therefore consistent (the earlier claim that origin names upstream for the kexin commits was wrong). Revision marks run batches, not judge variants (v2 logs record 545a638, a v1-era commit).

L-05 The patched re-run document at the pin is internally inconsistent: its table is said to be all v3, while its prose still quotes v1 values (Gemini Pro 27.3%, Flash-Lite 52.3%, SFT-v4 59.1%, GPT-4o 54.5%), and the 'where the data lives' paragraph says only Claude's JSONL rows are v3 while the content-filter document says all 880 rows are v3. Base Qwen 13.6% is identical in v1 and v3. Test whether the v3 table matches logs/patched-judge-v3 or partly logs/patched-judge.

L-06 Raw refusal flags in logs/ (and v1) are inflated by the redacted-reasoning rendering (5-B marker) for Gemini and Claude, per the author: contradictions score>=0.5 & refusal>=0.5 in 62 base samples (Flash-Lite 30, Claude 19, Pro 7, GPT-4o-mini 3, GPT-4o, Base Qwen and SFT-v5 1 each). Expected-known source property; datasheet should say refusal is the stock 8-B judge output.

L-07 #2439 (open): benign file tools fail outside the package directory with exactly inspect_ai 0.3.263 + inspect_evals 360484a; our census counted 530 file_not_found tool errors. If they fall on bundled benign files, benign completion scores are depressed by a harness defect (documentation-mismatch S2).
L-08 #2212 (open): judge API errors become 'no refusal'; the author hit API-key failures during the runs. Check refusal_explanations for judge error text.
L-09 #2312 (open): verdict substring parsing; not testable from data without re-judging; record as a disclosed limitation.
L-10 #2146: header avg_full_score at 0.20.0 drops integer-valued scores (fixed 2026-10-01); the author's tables do not use it.

L-11 Content-filter blind spot: Claude Sonnet 5 samples with stop_reason content_filter (8 harmful, 4-5 benign per run) have refusal = 0 in base/v1/v2 and 1 only in v3; the docs give their sample ids.

L-12 Missing logs by design of force-tracking: the pin commit adds 8-category Qwen results (analysis JSONL) with no .eval logs; the SFT-GRPO-v3 doc mentions two failed SkyPilot attempts whose logs are absent. Not part of the pinned data, but the analysis directory describes more runs than logs/ holds.

L-13 Behaviour subset and filter: every finished 44-sample log should use the same 44 Fraud+Cybercrime behaviour ids; the Claude Sonnet 4.5 log ran without the filter (dataset_samples 176, one Disinformation sample).
L-14 Claude Sonnet 5 does not accept temperature (author's note); the logged generate config may state a temperature that was not transmitted; logger events likely hold the warning.
L-15 Gemini 2.5 Pro: 15 samples completed purely through tool calls with no text (author), so refusal stays 0 by construction; relevant to empty-assistant-text counts.

L-16 Account paths: /eval/dataset/location (66 headers, two accounts) and /eval/model (18 logs) hold workstation paths; D-182 code exists but the profile has no redact table, so the 18 logs cannot be imported (security-relevant if any reaches AER/SEM/PROV).
L-17 Producer inspect_ai 0.3.263 is not on the verified producer code list: D-class rules should appear as _unverified twins.
L-18 Timing: each log's file-name start (UTC, -00-00 offset) precedes the commit that added it by minutes to hours; events after the adding commit would indicate a modified or replaced file.
